verdict.rationale: A government business-registry and filing service could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only web forms, online filing, payments and PDF downloads, with no OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The robots.txt probe is not about an API spec and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
